statement.zh: Naville《德尔拜赫里神庙》I（1895，EEF Memoir 13）以图版公布哈特谢普苏特神庙上层平台西北端。
statement.en: Naville’s The Temple of Deir el Bahari Part I (1895, EEF Memoir 13) publishes in plates the north-western end of the upper platform of Hatshepsut’s temple.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
